1453-4694-6797-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1453-4694-6797-7306.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing it to become a Spirit artifact creature in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

628-6495-7195.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Chaos Spewer.
When Chaos Spewer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Chaos Spewer enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
628-6495-7195.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-6972-7724.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Wakandan Royal Guard.
When Wakandan Royal Guard dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wakandan Royal Guard enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and is level 4 or higher

1318-2743-7694.description:
Cast Multiversal Incursion by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, activate Echo Mage by tapping it, copying Multiversal Incursion twice
Resolve all Multiversal Incursion spells, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

339-677-4460-5231.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1409-1770-5419.description:
Activate Kalain by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Kalain enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Kalain.
Resolve both Kalain triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

457-3110-5078-5390.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Forensic Gadgeteer triggers, creating a Clue token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping the Clue, adding {U}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Activate the Clue by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library.
Repeat.

147-3306.easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Slip On the Ring.
147-3306.description:
Cast Slip On the Ring by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Slip On the Ring, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Slip On the Ring, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

222-527-4050-6968.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {R}{G}{G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1818-2173-2511-5010.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
1818-2173-2511-5010.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
When Golgari Thug enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

654-1231-5147-6644.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Gravewaker by paying {5}{B}{B}, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers ten times, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

224-4913-5233-5310.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, causing you to draw a card and put Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield, and then repeat this process once if you control eight or more lands, putting any other land from your hand onto the battlefield instead.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, Bloodghast and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodghast trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone and Dina.
Repeat.

1371-3231-3432-6500.easyPrerequisites:
There is a land on the battlefield.
Each opponent has 80 or less life, or your life total is 81 or higher.
1371-3231-3432-6500.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Tephraderm indestructible.
1371-3231-3432-6500.description:
Give Tephraderm indestructible, if needed.
Cast Star of Extinction by paying {5}{R}{R}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Star of Extinction.
Resolve an opponent's Star of Extinction, destroying a land and dealing 40 damage to each creature and planeswalker due to Dictate of the Twin Gods.
Tephraderm's second ability triggers, dealing 80 damage to the opponent who controlled the Star of Extinction copy due to Dictate of the Twin Gods.
Repeat from step 4 for each remaining Star of Extinction, including your own if one or more opponents survive.

1846-3525-4348.easyPrerequisites:
You control an Island.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Ley Druid.
Ley Druid does not have summoning sickness.
1846-3525-4348.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping the Island.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Ley Druid.
Repeat from step 2

333-2034-2730.notablePrerequisites: Kaya's Ghostform attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-2034-2730.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos, adding {C}{C}.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Repeat.

1170-3821-6059.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{R}{R}
1170-3821-6059.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{R}{R}.
Cast Ghitu Firebreathing by paying its mana cost, targeting Displacer Kitten
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Peregrine Drake.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Ghitu Firebreathing spell.
Activate Ghitu Firebreathing by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

891-2523-4050-5515.easyPrerequisites: On Serra's Wings attached to Boonweaver Giant.
891-2523-4050-5515.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant, adding one mana of any color.
When Boonweaver Giant dies as a legendary creature due to On Serra's Wings, Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers, creating a token copy of Boonweaver Giant that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
When the Boonweaver Giant token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning On Serra's Wings from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token.
Repeat.

643-4338-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Maskwood Nexus, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

4891-5111-5220-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Atsushi, adding {R}.
When Atsushi dies, it and Mortuary trigger twice.
Resolve both Mortuary triggers, putting Atsushi on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the first Atsushi trigger, causing you to exile the top two cards of your library with the ability to play them until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the second Atsushi trigger, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}.
Cast Atsushi from exile by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1663-2232-2858-3273.description:
Pay {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice putting Chandra, Pyrogenius onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chandra, Torch of Defiance to your hand.
+2 Chandra, Pyrogenius dealing damage to each opponent.
Then pay {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice once again, putting Chandra, Torch of Defiance onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chandra, Pyrogenius to your hand.
+1 Chandra adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.
